sentences.text:
Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Syed Masleh Uddin Ashraf
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Sharda Kumari

======================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Anil Kumar Sinha

2 18-05-2023 Mr. S.M. Ashraf, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that during pendency of this anticipatory bail application the sole petitioner apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 693C of 2022 instituted under Section 498A of the IPC has been arrested.
As such, he seeks permission to withdraw this application.
The application stands dismissed as withdrawn.

(Anil Kumar Sinha, J) praful/-
